draft.title: Adaptations
card: An adaptation is a feature or behaviour that helps an organism survive and reproduce in its habitat. Adaptations are passed on to offspring over many generations.
a body part or shape. A camel's wide, flat feet spread its weight on sand. Many Australian plants have thick, waxy leaves that lose less water.
an action an organism does. A red kangaroo rests in shade during the heat of the day and feeds at dusk and dawn.
a process inside the body. Some desert animals, such as the spinifex hopping mouse, make very concentrated urine, so they lose little water.
draft.remember: Adaptations help survival: structural is a body part, behavioural is an action, physiological is an inside process.

a.q: A lizard in the Australian desert buries itself in cool sand during the hottest part of the day. What type of adaptation is this?
opts: Behavioural, because it is an action the lizard does
Structural, because the lizard uses its body to dig
Physiological, because it helps the lizard control its heat
Structural, because the sand changes the lizard's shape
a.why: Burying itself is something the lizard does, so it is a behavioural adaptation. Digging uses the body, but a structural adaptation is a body part or shape, not an action.
a.clue: Is it a body part, an action, or a process inside the body?

b.q: A desert plant in central Australia has leaves that are small, thick and covered in wax. Which statement best explains how this helps it survive?
opts: It is a structural adaptation that reduces water loss
It is a behavioural adaptation that reduces water loss
It is a physiological adaptation that reduces water loss
It is a structural adaptation that increases water uptake
b.why: Leaf size, thickness and wax are parts of the plant's body, so they are structural. They cut water lost from the leaves. Increasing water uptake is wrong, because these features act on the leaves, not on taking in water.
b.clue: Look at what the leaves are like, and what water does in dry places.

a.best: Behavioural, because it is an action the lizard does

b.best: It is a structural adaptation that reduces water loss
